summary_en: Gerbera holdings corrects its tender offer filing for METALART following receipt of FTC non-objection notice and expedited prohibition-period shortening notice dated 2 June 2026. Correction relates to withdrawal conditions under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Enforcement Regulation Article 14; tender price, share count, and acquisition parameters remain unchanged.
title_en: Notice Regarding Correction of Public Tender Offer Commencement Announcement in Connection with Submission of Corrected Public Tender Offer Filing by Gerbera holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 14 May 2026, Gerbera holdings Corporation decided to acquire all ordinary shares of METALART Corporation (TSE Standard Market, code 5644) via public tender offer, which commenced on 15 May 2026. The tender offer was originally filed on 15 May 2026. On 2 June 2026, Gerbera holdings received two notices from the Fair Trade Commission (FTC): (i) a notice of non-execution of exclusionary order, and (ii) a notice of expedited shortening of the prohibition period. In light of these FTC clearances, Gerbera holdings filed a corrected tender offer statement with the Kanto Financial Bureau on 10 June 2026. The correction pertains to withdrawal conditions under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Enforcement Regulation Article 14, specifically clarifying certain triggering events. The issuer confirms that this correction does not alter the purchase price, share count, number of shares to be acquired, or other material acquisition parameters as defined in Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 27-3(2)(1). Underlines in the document indicate the specific corrected passages.
